## Summary

7+ years as a Marketing Data Scientist/Analyst specializing in marketing measurement and incrementality. Built and maintained MMMs across ecommerce, finance, gambling & sports betting, and ad platforms; led geo-experimentation programs while building geo-testing tools to measure ROI across Google (Search/Display/YouTube), Meta, TikTok, X, email, and offline channels (radio, OOH).

## Experience

Founder of Oliver Brose Consulting since 2023, with contract and project roles at Wolt, Growth by Science, Stella, RSTM, Impact Soundworks and GetYourGuide. Before that, Data Analyst at Zalando (2019–2023) and Data Scientist at Allyouneed (2018–2019). Details on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/oliver-brose/).

## Education

- **M.Sc. Statistics**, Humboldt University Berlin, 2016–2019
- **B.Sc. Business Administration**, Humboldt University Berlin, 2012–2016
